question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

One who does not believe in the existence of God
solution:
The correct answer is: **Atheist.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Atheist"** means a person who does not believe in the existence of God. (नास्तिक)

 
 
• **Example: **John identifies as an atheist and does not participate in religious activities.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Atheist**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Priest** (पुजारी): A person who performs religious ceremonies and duties.

 
 
• **Example:** The priest led the congregation in prayer.
 
 
 
• **Monk** (साधु): A member of a religious community of men typically living under vows of poverty, chastity, and obedience.
 
 
• **Example:** The monk spent his days in meditation and prayer.
 
 
 
• **Believer** (विश्वासी): A person who has faith in the existence of God or gods.
 
 
• **Example:** She is a strong believer in the power of prayer.
